**v1.11.2: the battle simulator saves pips for a hit that ends the battle - "Save pips for a finishing hit" (`pipsave`) - as the bot does. It matters most for a deck with two big hits a pip apart against a boss (a Storm Lord beside a Tempest), and then by half a point at most in the decks measured; a deck with one kind of hit and no item card's hit plays the same battles as before (a wand's hit can now wait for a saved hit).**
- **What was wrong.** The simulator (the boss deck pick, the planner, the zone deck) never saved pips: a hit it could pay for went, even while a bigger one a pip or two away would end the battle. The bot, when nothing in hand ends the battle this round, saves its pips for a hit that will: one of its slot hits in hand that costs more than the pips it has, at most `pipsave` rounds away (3 by default, counting a pip a round), and that would kill every enemy (an AoE) or the last one once it can be paid for - counted as the kill check counts it, the aura only if it lasts that long, with the enchant in hand or without - and only while your health is at least `pipsavehealth` % (50). Meanwhile it casts no other hit and plans that one, so its blades and traps go on for it, past "Boosts before each hit" (`boostmax`) too; the wand's hit goes only if the saved hit would kill without the blades, traps and aura on. It gives up for the battle after `pipsave` + 1 rounds saving for one hit, or the same pips three rounds running.
- **What changes.** The simulator now saves pips the bot's way: the same hits, the same tests, the same count; in the team plan a hitter keeps its own count, and a party's Blader or Healer never saves, as the bot doesn't. Your `pipsave` and a deck's own are used - the AutoFarmer has always sent it; `pipsavehealth` isn't sent, so the simulator takes the bot's default, 50. Nothing changes in the game: the bot plays as it always has, there is no new setting, and the AutoFarmer sends the helper nothing new.
- **Measured on the same dice** (2000 battles a cell, each battle on the same seed in v1.11.1 and v1.11.2): v1.11.1's wizard, enemies and 19 decks, and 5 more (a wand's Lightning Strike beside one kind of hit and beside two; a Storm Lord beside a 4-pip Kraken or a 5-pip Storm Hound; Tempest + Kraken), against the boss and 3 mobs, with 8 sets of settings: `discardspent` on (the default) and off, `reboost` on, "Hit first (fast)", `boostmax` 1 and 2, `boostmax` 1 with "Hit first (fast)" and with `reboost` on. 325 of the 384 cells play the same battles, battle for battle, 372 win the same number, and none moves by more than 10 battles in 2000.
  - **Decks with one kind of hit: the same battles in all 208 cells** (13 decks, the two Hydra decks and the wand deck among them), though some save pips in up to 2 battles of 3 against the boss (8 Storm Lord + 3 Elemental Blade + 3 Stormblade + 3 Sharpened Blade in 58-67%, 8 Storm Lord + 6 Stormblade + 6 Storm Trap + 2 Sharpened Blade + 2 Potent Trap in 48-59%): the hit saved for is the one they planned anyway, no other deck hit could be paid for, and the wand deck's Lightning Strike never had to wait for a saved hit.
  - **A cheap hit cast every round keeps the pips low**: 10 Thunder Snake + 6 Storm Lord + 4 Sharpened Blade and the Fire Cat + Hydra deck never save (the same battles everywhere); 6 Storm Lord + 4 Fire Cat + 4 Stormblade + 2 Fireblade saves in at most 6.4% of the battles and wins the same number everywhere.
  - **3 mobs: every deck wins the same number** but one, by one battle (6 Storm Lord + 6 Thunder Snake + 4 Stormblade + 4 Storm Trap with `reboost` on, 829 -> 830): a one-enemy hit ends a 3-mob battle only on the last mob.
  - **What moves - the boss.** 4 Storm Lord + 4 Tempest + 3 Stormblade + 3 Storm Trap + 2 Feint + 2 Sharpened Blade + 2 Potent Trap, where the 7-pip Storm Lord is saved for while the 6-pip Tempest could go (pips saved in 29-44% of the battles, a Tempest held back in 15-23%): 95.8% -> 96.0% (+5 / -2); with `reboost` on 97.9% -> 97.9% (+4 / -4); "Hit first (fast)" 90.2% -> 90.7% (+17 / -7); `discardspent` off 94.8% -> 95.2% (+8 / -2); `boostmax` 1 93.6% -> 93.8% (+9 / -5), a boost past it in 3.0% of the battles. With `reboost` on, a cheap hit and a big one save more often - each hit frees the blades and traps again, so the big one on top of them ends the boss more often - and end where they were: 6 Storm Lord + 6 Thunder Snake + 4 Stormblade + 4 Storm Trap 92.7% -> 92.5% (+4 / -7), pips saved in 17.4%; with 6 Storm Shark instead and 2 Sharpened Blade 98.2% -> 98.2% (+1 / -1), 26.8%; with 6 Kraken 99.5% -> 99.5% (the same won and lost), 35.5%; 4 Thunder Snake + 2 Storm Lord + 6 Stormblade + 6 Storm Trap + 2 Sharpened Blade 30.1% -> 30.1% (+16 / -16).
  - In no cell did the bot's give-up come into play, nor a wand's hit wait for a saved one.
- **The simulator plays everything else exactly as before**, against v1.11.1: on its 270 random decks (9990 comparisons: 8100 simulate, 1350 planner as Hitter, Blader and Healer, 270 team plan and 270 deck pick), all 7201 comparisons in which no pips were saved came out the same, and so did the 752 in which pips were saved but every card picked was the one v1.11.1 picks there. The 1929 that differ all saved pips. The 40 decks with one kind of deck hit and no item card play the same everywhere (1440 comparisons, pips saved in 226); the 16 with an item card too differ in 4 of their 576. 150 of the 270 decks play the same everywhere.
- **Mixed versions are fine.** Every v1.x AutoFarmer saves pips this way, so an older one with this helper gets it too: it sends its `pipsave` with the boss deck pick and the planner, and with the zone deck from v1.7.0 on (before that the zone deck takes the bot's default 3). This AutoFarmer with an older helper: that helper's way, as before. The zone deck is worked out once more after updating.
- **Nothing to try in the game.** The bot plays as before, so there is no LIVE_CHECKS step. To compare with the bot, debug.log's "saving pips for hitN (C pips, you have P): it ends the battle - ..." names the hit it saves for, "hitM: not cast - saving pips for hitN" the one it holds back, and "not saving pips for hitN: ..." or "saved pips for hitN R round(s) and still can't cast it - ..." when it doesn't or gives up; the dashboard counts "Rounds saving pips".
- **Still not in it:** of saving pips, your own `pipsavehealth` (not sent: the simulator takes 50), your health or pips unread (the bot then saves none), `hit4` saved for only on a boss you picked and of two hits as near, the first slot (the simulator's any deck hit, the first in hand), and in the planner the rounds already saved (not sent: its count starts at the round it plans); the bot's hit slots (`hit4` only on a boss you picked; of two hits that deal the same, the first of `hit4` to `hit1` - the simulator's the first in hand; a hit learned in no slot, planned only with no slot hit in hand and cast after them; with the game's hand not read, the first slot hit it can pay for); a pet's or another gear's hit card of your school, which the bot casts as a learned hit in no slot - the simulator plays every item card's hit as the wand's and doesn't read `usewand`; the traps in the planned hit's damage, the kill check and pip saving's test with `solotraps` off (the default: the bot counts none there; the simulator counts the ones on, and for the planned hit the ones in hand too); a Blader's or Healer's boosts for the hitter's planned hit (the simulator's for the hitter's hit in hand with the biggest damage); with every hit switched off and the game's hand read, the bot's boosts for the strongest hit in that hand (the simulator's for your school's); the prism, Attenuate and your school's bubble in the bot's boost chain; your own PlayerStats.txt %s for Balanceblade, Bladestorm, Hex and Feint (`blade3`, `blade4`, `trap3`, `feint`); the enemies' cheats.
- **Updating:** the updater offers this to every install, including ones set up from the v0.7.0 or v0.7.1 zips. Your settings, learned cards and routes are kept. A copy run from the code: git pull.
